description: This source file defines CLI commands for database management in the Mattermost project, including initialization, reset, migration, downgrade, and version retrieval, utilizing Cobra CLI framework and external packages for database and file store operations.

classes.name: cobra.Command
classes.description: Defines CLI commands for database operations such as init, reset, migrate, downgrade, and version.

methods.name: initDbCmdF
methods.description: Initializes the database connection and configuration store, and confirms store creation.

methods.name: resetCmdF
methods.description: Resets the database by dropping all tables after user confirmation.

methods.name: migrateCmdF
methods.description: Generates and optionally saves a migration plan, then applies migrations to the database.

methods.name: downgradeCmdF
methods.description: Downgrades the database either by specified versions or by applying a plan from a file.

methods.name: dbVersionCmdF
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the current database schema version or all applied migrations.

methods.name: ConfigToFileBackendSettings
methods.description: Converts file settings configuration into a filestore backend settings object, supporting local and S3 backends.
